meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 Matrix 聊天通道接入项目:复制适配器、注册到通道列表、安装依赖、修补导入,再跑构建和测试。机器人可收发 Matrix 房间/私聊消息。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Matrix 消息通道,或要求给项目配一个 Matrix 机器人时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 接入这个项目。
say.note: 会自动执行复制、注册、安装和测试。

say.text: 给项目添加 Matrix 频道,需要单独的机器人账号。
say.note: 会提示你提供 homeserver 和账号信息。

say.text: 用密码登录方式配置 Matrix 机器人。
say.note: 按提示填用户名、密码等环境变量。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill lets Claude add Matrix chat channel support to the project: it copies the adapter, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, patches ESM imports, then runs build and tests. The bot can then exchange Matrix room/DM messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Matrix messaging to the project or mentions setting up a Matrix bot.

say_en.note: It will copy, register, install, patch, and test.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel; it needs a separate bot account.
say_en.note: It will prompt for homeserver and account details.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with password login.
say_en.note: You'll be prompted for username, password, etc.
